Laminate Flooring

We supply and fit quality laminate floors in family homes, hallways, bedrooms and living spaces across Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire.

Call 07748 146181 WhatsApp Us

Practical and Cost-Effective

Laminate flooring is a practical, stylish and cost-effective way to transform any room.

Modern laminate offers realistic wood and stone finishes, excellent durability and easy maintenance, making it ideal for busy family homes, hallways, bedrooms and living spaces.

Signs you may need new flooring include swollen boards, chipped edges, scratches, movement or outdated finishes.

How We Fit Laminate

At Fairmont Flooring, we believe a quality laminate installation starts with proper preparation.

We begin by inspecting the existing floor, checking levels and ensuring the subfloor is clean, dry and suitable for installation.

We supply quality laminate flooring in a wide range of realistic wood and contemporary finishes, using suitable underlays, moisture protection and professional installation accessories.

Our fitters carefully measure, cut and install every board, paying particular attention to expansion gaps, doorways, transitions and finishing trims.

We take pride in leaving every installation clean, accurately finished and ready to enjoy.

A Recent Job: Laminate Flooring Transformation

Aberdeen

Fairmont Flooring recently undertook a laminate flooring installation for a homeowner looking to modernise their property. The existing flooring was tired and showing signs of wear, so we recommended a fresh, contemporary finish. What Others Get Wrong

One of the most common problems with laminate flooring installations is poor preparation and rushed workmanship.

We often see issues caused by unsuitable underlays, insufficient expansion gaps, poorly finished edges and flooring installed over uneven or damp subfloors.

These shortcuts can lead to movement, lifting, gaps and damaged boards.

At Fairmont Flooring, we take the time to inspect and prepare every surface correctly, use quality laminate products and suitable underlays, and ensure all expansion allowances, joints and finishing trims are correctly installed.

We believe even an affordable flooring option deserves a professional finish.

How Long It Takes and What It Costs

Most installations take approximately 1 to 2 days, depending on the room size and preparation required.

Fairmont Flooring supplies and installs quality laminate flooring, with prices typically starting from £45 to £75 per m².

Every quote is free and no-obligation, and follows an assessment of your project.
